subject: Upcoming Company Picnic Details
body: Dear Team, I hope this message finds you well. I am excited to announce that our annual company picnic will be held on Saturday, July 24th at Central Park. The event will start at 11:00 AM with various team-building activities and games planned throughout the day. A delicious barbecue lunch will be provided, and feel free to bring your favorite sides to share. Please RSVP by July 10th so we can finalize the headcount. Looking forward to a fun day of relaxation and team bonding! Best regards, [Your Name]
